cards.name: You're On Mute
cards.caption: You're on mute, Kevin
cards.flavor: 2020: said more than 'hello.' Unmute yourself. No, the OTHER button.
cards.art: Video-call tile with a cute round blob passionately talking, a big red crossed-out microphone icon in the corner, empty speech bubble. Background: faint lavender grid of other call tiles. Colors: lavender, red, white, peach.

cards.name: Lord Yeastington
cards.caption: Feed me. Every. Day.
cards.flavor: 2020: everyone adopted a sourdough starter, named it, and became its servant.
cards.art: Glass jar of bubbly beige dough with a monocled face and a tiny crown, bubbles popping out the top, wooden spoon beside it. Background: warm kitchen tiles. Colors: beige, glass blue, gold, brown.

cards.name: Whipped Dalgona
cards.caption: Whisk 400 times. Worth it
cards.flavor: Korea to the world, 2020: fluffy whipped coffee on milk, lockdown's first TikTok hit.
cards.art: Tall glass of milk topped with a fluffy caramel-brown whipped cloud that has a proud smiling face, a whisk leaning on the glass. Background: soft cream. Colors: caramel, milk white, cream, brown.

cards.name: Bing Chilling Cone
cards.caption: Now I have bing chilling
cards.flavor: 2021: a viral Mandarin clip made 'ice cream' (bīngqílín) an eternal meme.
cards.art: Vanilla ice cream cone in tiny sunglasses giving a calm thumbs-up, frosty sparkles and chilly breath puffs. Background: icy pale blue with snowflakes. Colors: vanilla, waffle tan, ice blue, black.

cards.name: Vibing Cat
cards.caption: Head bob intensifies
cards.flavor: 2020: a white cat bobbing to a Finnish polka became the official sound of vibing.
cards.art: White cat with closed happy eyes bobbing its head (three ghosted head positions), music notes floating. Background: teal. Colors: white, teal, pink, black.

cards.name: Stick Bug
cards.caption: Get stick bugged lol
cards.flavor: 2020's bait-and-switch: any video could suddenly cut to a swaying stick insect.
cards.art: Lanky brown stick insect on a leaf swaying side to side with a smug face, little 'LOL' sparkles. Background: leafy green. Colors: twig brown, leaf green, yellow, white.

cards.name: Polish Cow
cards.caption: *Polish music plays*
cards.flavor: 2020–21: a cow dancing to a Polish banger, looped for hours. Peak 3 a.m. internet.
cards.art: Black-and-white cow standing on hind legs doing a stiff, wobbly dance, head tilted, tiny music notes. Background: simple red-and-white split. Colors: white, black, red, pink.

cards.name: It's Corn
cards.caption: IT'S CORN! (has the juice)
cards.flavor: 2022: one kid's pure love for corn became a song. A big lump with knobs!
cards.art: Golden corn cob with a huge joyful open-mouth grin, arms raised in celebration, husk leaves flapping like a cape, juice sparkles. Background: sky blue. Colors: corn yellow, husk green, sky blue, white.

cards.name: I'm Not a Kitten
cards.caption: I'm not a cat.
cards.flavor: 2021: a court video call, a stuck kitten filter, and the most sincere denial ever.
cards.art: Video-call window showing a fluffy white kitten face with huge glossy worried eyes, a tiny suit collar and tie, a small gavel in the corner. Background: wood paneling. Colors: white, navy, wood brown, red.

cards.name: Ever Stuck
cards.caption: Tiny digger, giant job
cards.flavor: 2021: one giant ship wedged across the Suez Canal vs. one very brave tiny digger.
cards.art: Huge container ship jammed diagonally between sandy banks, generic multicolor containers, and one tiny yellow excavator scooping bravely with a determined face. Background: blue water strip and sky. Colors: teal hull, red/orange/blue containers, sand, yellow.

cards.name: Big Floppa
cards.caption: Floppa is friend
cards.flavor: 2020–21: a caracal with giant ear tufts became the internet's beloved big cat.
cards.art: Plump caracal with giant black ear tufts and a calm, unimpressed face, sitting like a loaf. Background: warm beige. Colors: tawny orange, black, cream, beige.

cards.name: Toilet Paper King
cards.caption: Worth more than gold
cards.flavor: March 2020: shelves emptied and rolls hoarded. The one true currency of lockdown.
cards.art: Toilet paper roll wearing a jeweled crown and red royal cape, seated on a throne of stacked rolls, holding a scepter, smug face. Background: golden rays. Colors: white, gold, royal red, purple.
